STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_194211.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_194211.v · Open raw
module origen_194211(
    input           ClkEngress,
    input           ARst,
    input   [31:0]  WriteData,
    input           WriteDataValid,
    output reg [7:0] Data,
    output reg       DataValid,
    output reg       Ready
);

    reg [1:0]  byteNum;
    reg [31:0] writeDataSave;

    always @(posedge ClkEngress or posedge ARst) begin
        if (ARst) begin
            byteNum <= 2'b00;
            DataValid <= 1'b0;
            Ready <= 1'b1;
        end
        else begin
            if (Ready && WriteDataValid) begin
                writeDataSave <= WriteData;
                Ready <= 1'b0;
            end

            case (byteNum)
                2'b00: begin
                    Data <= writeDataSave[7:0];
                    DataValid <= 1'b1;
                    byteNum <= 2'b01;
                end
                2'b01: begin
                    Data <= writeDataSave[15:8];
                    DataValid <= 1'b1;
                    byteNum <= 2'b10;
                end
                2'b10: begin
                    Data <= writeDataSave[23:16];
                    DataValid <= 1'b1;
                    byteNum <= 2'b11;
                    Ready <= 1'b1;
                end
                2'b11: begin
                    Data <= writeDataSave[31:24];
                    DataValid <= 1'b1;
                    byteNum <= 2'b00;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
